$comment: SPEC §24.2 design tokens — SINGLE SOURCE. Light/reading + complete night/dusk set (§34.8), §29.4 semantic layer, §0.12 motion, per-script typography for the six launch scripts (§2.3/§24.2). PRIMITIVE colour values are FROZEN by §24.2/§34.8 — changing one is §31.3 change control. SEMANTIC tokens alias a primitive wherever an alias exists; where §29.4 names a token the frozen palette has no primitive for, the value is derived by the §24.2 hue-shift rule (same hue, +8-12% lightness, -15% saturation for night) and is AA-verified numerically by scripts/token-lint.mjs against src/contrast-matrix.json. gold = interactive/sacred/celebratory only (§0.13); caution never red-alarm for astrology content; danger = system errors only.

surface-raised.$comment: §29.4 — raised reads by elevation, not by hue (light theme's reading surface is already the lightest value)

surface-sunken.$comment: §29.4 — sunken = canvas cream behind a raised card

on-gold.$comment: ink on a gold fill — 6.16:1; identical in both themes so a gold button never re-colours its label at dusk

gold.$comment: spec names this brand.gold; kept top-level so the night theme's gold token overrides the same CSS var

subtle.$comment: §29.4 — alias of line; decorative dividers only

strong.$comment: derived on line's hue (46.7°) to clear 3:1 on both surfaces — the boundary of an interactive control (WCAG 1.4.11)

primary.$comment: alias of gold — a gold element is always tappable, sacred or celebratory (§0.13)

hover.$comment: derived: gold darkened on-hue; text.on-gold stays 5.38:1

pressed.$comment: derived: darkest gold that keeps text.on-gold ≥4.5:1 (4.64:1)

disabled.$comment: alias of line; label uses ink.muted at 3.75:1

success.$comment: fill/icon and body text — 4.67:1 on canvas

caution.$comment: FILL/ICON ONLY — 3.96:1 on canvas fails body text

caution-text.$comment: derived on caution's hue for body copy — 4.52:1 on canvas

danger-strong.$comment: emphasis fill for a filled destructive control (end-call), carrying text-on-brand at ≥4.5:1

auspicious.$comment: §29.4 gold-green tint — FILL/ICON/BAR only (3.76:1); never encoded by colour alone

auspicious-text.$comment: derived on-hue for labels — 4.58:1 on canvas

care.$comment: §29.4 amber, NEVER red — alias of caution; fill/icon only

ring-outer.$comment: gold alone is 2.42:1 on cream and cannot satisfy WCAG 2.2 focus-indicator contrast; the ring ships as gold + a navy outer contour at 12.93:1, so the indicator as a whole passes without altering the frozen gold value

surface-raised.$comment: hue-shift of surface: same hue, +5% lightness, -15% saturation

strong.$comment: derived on line's hue (232.8°) to clear 3:1 on both night surfaces

danger.$comment: FILL/ICON ONLY at night — 3.5:1 on night surface

danger-text.$comment: hue-shift lightened for body copy — 4.51:1 on night surface

danger-strong.$comment: The night danger tone is a mid-value: NO text passes 4.5:1 on it, in either direction (3.67 with ink, 3.39 with on-gold). A filled destructive control therefore uses this darkened-on-hue emphasis fill, which carries text-on-brand at 4.55:1. Its own boundary against the night surface is 2.82:1, so such a control must also carry border-strong — which is why every filled control in the library does.

info.$comment: brand.navy's hue lifted per the hue-shift rule — 6.36:1

auspicious.$comment: hue-shift of the light auspicious tint — 4.56:1 on night surface

ring.$comment: night gold clears 3:1 on both night surfaces unaided (7.78:1)

launch.$comment: §0.11 launch sequence — THEME-INVARIANT by design. These sit outside `color` so the build emits them once at :root and the night block never overrides them: §0.11 fixes the palette ("No other hues permitted in the sequence") and the arrival is one brand moment, not a themed surface. sky-top/sky-bottom, line, bloom and wordmark repeat the values already carried by color.light.brand.navy-deep, brand.navy, gold and gold-soft — deliberately, because those four shift at dusk and the sequence must not. The canvas reads these with getComputedStyle; nothing here becomes a Tailwind utility.

script.$comment: §24.2 per-script overrides are TOKENS, not hacks. Latin is the untuned baseline; the five Indic scripts carry the frozen tuning. Applied via [data-script] in dist/css/tokens.css.

reading.$comment: §0.13 — reading surfaces target ≤65 characters per line

motion.$comment: §0.12 — 200-400ms standard, 600-900ms ceremonial; easing family FIXED. Nothing bounces except Tara's celebration nod; nothing loops except idle breathing and star twinkle. Every duration collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion / [data-motion=reduced].

presence.$comment: §24.3 TaraPresence ships in four sizes; §24.1 fixes the collapsed header chip at 56px. `full` is the full-bleed call layout and is expressed by the layout, not by a size token.

height.$comment: §29.4 form controls are 48px, label-above (floating labels fail Indic scripts)

shadow.$comment: The outer contour that carries WCAG 2.2 non-text contrast for the indicator. Light gold is 2.26:1 on cream and cannot do it alone; this paints beneath the gold outline so the ring stays exactly 2px at a 2px offset per §29.4, with the offset band rendering in ring-outer. At night the gold clears 3:1 unaided and the contour is canvas-coloured, i.e. invisible.

breakpoint.$comment: §29.3 — components rearrange at these widths, they never merely scale.

xs.$comment: the narrow floor — practical strip wraps 2×2, tab labels hide, composer icons collapse

phone.$comment: start of the 360–430 design target — everything renders as drawn

sm.$comment: large phones portrait — contextual cards go 2-up

lg.$comment: desktop — left rail replaces the tab bar

sound.$comment: §29.4 sound tokens — subtle, OFF by default, following system sound settings. Values are asset paths under the web app's /public.
